maren.name: Old Maren
maren.description: The chapel's last keeper, wrapped in three shawls and a great deal of disapproval.
maren.greeting: She looks you over as if pricing you for a coffin.

merchant.name: Tallow the Peddler
merchant.description: A small figure under a very large pack, perfectly at home in the dark. Its lantern burns green.

shop.greeting: Everything fell off a wagon. Some of it fell quite a long way.
shop.farewell: Come back alive! Dead customers haggle terribly.

bone_rat.name: Bone Rat
bone_rat.description: A rat that kept going after the rest of it stopped. Mostly teeth and spite.

moves.name: A leaping bite
moves.tell: The bone rat coils, clicking, ready to spring.

bone_rat.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

gloom_bat.name: Gloom Bat
gloom_bat.description: A bat the size of a cloak. Darkness comes off its wings like smoke.
gloom_bat.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

crypt_crawler.name: Crypt Crawler
crypt_crawler.description: Too many legs, too few eyes, and all of them on you.
crypt_crawler.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

bone_warden.name: The Bone Warden
bone_warden.description: A skeleton in the rags of a gatekeeper's livery, a rusted halberd across its shoulders. It has been waiting a long time and does not mind.

moves.name: The overhead chop
moves.tell: The Bone Warden raises its halberd high, joints creaking.

bone_warden.greeting: It stands before the stair down, motionless, watching.
bone_warden.battle_intro: The Bone Warden turns its skull toward you and levels its halberd.
bone_warden.defeat_text: The Bone Warden comes apart, bone by bone, with something like relief.

drowned_thrall.name: Drowned Thrall
drowned_thrall.description: It was a miner once. Water runs from its mouth when it tries to speak.

moves.name: A crushing grab
moves.tell: The thrall spreads its arms wide, dripping.

drowned_thrall.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

mire_leech.name: Mire Leech
mire_leech.description: A leech as long as your arm, pale and patient.
mire_leech.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

rust_knight.name: Rust Knight
rust_knight.description: A suit of armour with nothing inside but rust and a grudge.

moves.name: The two-handed swing
moves.tell: The Rust Knight draws its sword back in both gauntlets.

rust_knight.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

tide_hag.name: The Tide Hag
tide_hag.description: She rises from the flooded stair, hair like weed, humming a tune you almost know.

moves.name: The rising tide
moves.tell: The water around the Tide Hag draws back from the walls, gathering behind her.

tide_hag.greeting: She waits waist-deep where the stair goes down, humming.
tide_hag.battle_intro: The humming stops. 'Mine,' says the Tide Hag.
tide_hag.defeat_text: The Tide Hag sinks, still humming, and the water goes still.

ash_wraith.name: Ash Wraith
ash_wraith.description: A shape of drifting cinders around two points of light.

moves.name: The cinder storm
moves.tell: The wraith spins faster, drawing every spark in the room into itself.

ash_wraith.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

hollow_guard.name: Hollow Guard
hollow_guard.description: Royal armour, royal crest, and nothing whatsoever inside the helm.

moves.name: The executioner's sweep
moves.tell: The Hollow Guard plants its feet and swings the glaive back.

hollow_guard.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.

hollow_king.name: The Hollow King
hollow_king.description: He sits where he has sat for a hundred years, the Ember Crown burning on a brow that is no longer there. The armour stands. The eyes are two coals.

moves.name: The Crown's Fire
moves.tell: The coals of the Crown blaze white. The King lifts one gauntlet, and the air begins to shake.

hollow_king.greeting: It has not noticed you. Yet.
hollow_king.ambush_text: The doors boom shut behind you. On the throne, two coals open.
hollow_king.battle_intro: 'ANOTHER,' says the Hollow King, rising. 'GOOD. I WAS COLD.'
hollow_king.defeat_text: The Hollow King kneels, slowly, as armour does when nothing holds it up. The Crown rolls to your feet, still burning.

on_defeat.say: The {item}Ember Crown{/} lies on the flagstones. All you have to do is take it.
